mostWorthwhile.text: Following the disk material back into the nursery was most worthwhile because it connected the planetary system to its galactic surroundings.

leastWorthwhile.text: Neither action was confusing, but both were fairly direct matches, leaving little need to explore alternatives.

surprise.text: The gas and dust escaped early even though the rocky world continued experiencing impacts much later.

arbitrary.text: Neither action felt arbitrary; both followed the visible goals and available objects.

continue.text: I would consider continuing to see where the returned material goes, though I would hope for more demanding choices than these two direct combinations.
